## Change

Describe the concrete trigger and resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the commands you ran (normally `bun run check`) and any relevant disposable-workdir smoke test.

## Cleanup safety, if applicable

List the exact targets that can change, the plan/confirmation behavior, live rechecks, and protected paths covered by tests.

## Registry contributions, if applicable

Link the request issue (`Closes #number`), cite owner documentation for the exact target, and explain the selector and safety tier. Ask a maintainer to apply the `registry` label so the changelog groups the entry. The merged PR author's GitHub handle is credited automatically.
